name: Akicon
blurb: A fan-run anime convention at Prague's KC Zahrada, built around artist alley and cosplay competitions rather than flown-in celebrity guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Akicon 2026 23. - 25. října, Praha, KC Zahrada'.

notes: This year's theme is sports anime ('Akicon na téma sportovních anime'). The site's full nav (Artist Alley, competitions — AJ-DO-RU, cosplay, CosPlyš — regular programming blocks, cosplay prints, AMV hell, flea market) has no guests/hosté section across the 15+ past editions it lists (2006-2025), and a direct /hoste URL just redirects to the homepage, so guests is 'none' rather than 'none-yet'.
